parameter.label: GRUPO : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT TOP.GRUPO AS VALUE, TOP.GRUPO AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE GOLSINAL= -1 ORDER BY 1

parameter.label: CODEMP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT EMP.CODEMP AS VALUE, EMP.CODEMP || '- '||EMP.RAZAOSOCIAL AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP EMP ORDER BY 1

simple-value.expression: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' THEN SUM(VALOR) END) SOMAA, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'B' THEN SUM(VALOR) END) SOMAB, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(VALOR) END) SOMAC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' THEN SUM(VALOR) END)/SUM(VALOR) AS PERCA, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'B' THEN SUM(VALOR) END)/SUM(VALOR) AS PERCB, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(VALOR) END)/SUM(VALOR) AS PERCC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' THEN COUNT(RANKING) END) QTDEA, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'B' THEN COUNT(RANKING) END) QTDEB, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'C' THEN COUNT(RANKING) END) QTDEC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' THEN SUM(KG) END) QTDEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'B' THEN SUM(KG) END) QTDEITB, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(KG) END) QTDEITC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' THEN SUM(KG) END)/SUM(KG) PERCQTDEITA, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'B' THEN SUM(KG) END)/SUM(KG) PERCQTDEITB, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(KG) END)/SUM(KG) PERCQTDEITC, (100-(:A+:B)) AS VLRC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' OR CURVA = 'B' OR CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(VALOR) END) SOMAABC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' OR CURVA = 'B' OR CURVA = 'C' THEN COUNT(RANKING) END) QTDEABC, SUM(CASE WHEN CURVA = 'A' OR CURVA = 'B' OR CURVA = 'C' THEN SUM(KG) END) QTDEITABC FROM ( select CODIGO, /*DESCRICAO, */ SUM(VALORANT) AS VALOR, SUM(SUM(VALORANT)) OVER (ORDER BY 3 desc ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ACUMULADO, (sum(sum(VALORANT)) OVER ())*0.8 AS VALORTOT, (sum(sum(VALORANT)) OVER ()) AS TOTAL, (SUM(VALORANT) / (sum(sum(VALORANT)) OVER ()))*100 AS PERC, (SUM(SUM(VALORANT)) OVER (ORDER BY 3 desc ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)/(sum(sum(VALORANT)) OVER ()))*100 AS PERCACUM, SUM(KGANT) AS KG, ROWNUM AS RANKING, CASE WHEN ROWNUM <= ROUND(((SUM(COUNT(ROWNUM)) OVER ()))*(:A/100)) THEN 'A' WHEN ROWNUM > ROUND(((SUM(COUNT(ROWNUM)) OVER ()))*(:A/100)) AND ROWNUM <= ROUND(((SUM(COUNT(ROWNUM)) OVER ()))*(:A/100))+ROUND(((SUM(COUNT(ROWNUM)) OVER ()))*(:B/100)) THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END CURVA, SUM(VALORANT)/SUM(KGANT) AS VALORMEDIO, ((SUM(SUM(KGANT)) OVER ())) AS TOTA, ((MAX(MAX(ROWNUM)) OVER ())) AS QTDPRODUTO FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR ELSE PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.NOMEPARC END AS CODIGO, /*CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.DESCRPROD ELSE PAR.NOMEPARC END AS DESCRICAO,*/ SUM ((((ITE.VLRTOT + NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS,0)) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END)) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS) AS VALORANT, sum(ITE.QTDNEG) AS KGANT FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFPAR PAR, TGFITE ITE, TGFPRO PRO, TGFGRU GRU, TGFTOP TPO, VGFCAB VCAB, TGFVEN VEN WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL= -1 AND CAB.CODVEND= VEN.CODVEND AND VCAB.NUNOTA= CAB.NUNOTA AND PRO.CODGRUPOPROD= GRU.CODGRUPOPROD AND TPO.GRUPO IN :GRUPO AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND ((CAB.CODPARC= :CODPARC) OR (:CODPARC IS NULL)) AND ((CAB.CODVEND= :CODVEND) OR (:CODVEND IS NULL)) AND ((GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :PGRUPO) OR (:PGRUPO IS NULL)) AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER GROUP BY CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR ELSE PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.NOMEPARC END/*, CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.DESCRPROD ELSE PAR.NOMEPARC END*/ order by 2 desc) GROUP BY CODIGO, /*DESCRICAO,*/ ROWNUM order by 2 desc) GROUP BY CURVA, VALOR, KG

grid.expression: WITH BASE AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR ELSE PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.NOMEPARC END AS CODIGO, SUM(((ITE.VLRTOT + NVL(ITE.AD_VLROUTROS,0)) - CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END * VCAB.INDITENS) AS VALOR, SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) AS KG FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFGRU GRU ON GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = PRO.CODGRUPOPROD INNER JOIN TGFTOP TPO ON TPO.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TPO.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER INNER JOIN VGFCAB VCAB ON VCAB.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFVEN VEN ON VEN.CODVEND = CAB.CODVEND WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND TPO.GRUPO IN :GRUPO AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP IN :CODEMP AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND ((CAB.CODPARC = :CODPARC) OR (:CODPARC IS NULL)) AND ((CAB.CODVEND = :CODVEND) OR (:CODVEND IS NULL)) AND ((GRU.CODGRUPOPROD = :PGRUPO) OR (:PGRUPO IS NULL)) GROUP BY CASE WHEN ':@ANALISE' = 'Produtos' THEN PRO.AD_AGRUPADOR ELSE PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.NOMEPARC END ), FINAL AS ( SELECT CODIGO, VALOR, SUM(VALOR) OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ACUMULADO, (SUM(VALOR) OVER ()) * 0.8 AS VALORTOT, (VALOR / NULLIF(SUM(VALOR) OVER (), 0)) * 100 AS PERC, (SUM(VALOR) OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / NULLIF(SUM(VALOR) OVER (), 0)) * 100 AS PERCACUM, KG, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC) AS RANKING, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC) <= ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:A/100)) THEN 'A' WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC) <= ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:A/100)) + ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:B/100)) THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS CURVA, CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC) <= ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:A/100)) THEN '#E8F5E9' WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY VALOR DESC) <= ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:A/100)) + ROUND(COUNT(*) OVER () * (:B/100)) THEN '#FFF3E0' ELSE '#FFEBEE' END AS BKCOLOR, (VALOR / NULLIF(KG, 0)) AS VALORMEDIO, SUM(KG) OVER () AS QTDTOTAL, COUNT(*) OVER () AS QTDPRODUTO FROM BASE ) SELECT * FROM FINAL ORDER BY VALOR DESC
